delivery_structure.value: Question-led definition by correction, with the piece's own counting demonstration as its delivery centrepiece: definition question, cold (L1, 2.20–3.74 s: 'Quick: what is a token?') → correction (L2, 3.74–8.94 s: 'Not a word.') → machine's-eye three-way contrast (L3, 8.94–12.92 s: letters struck, words struck, tokens) → live self-counting demonstration, the longest line (L4, 12.92–22.84 s: 'Count with me: The. Machine. Reads. Tokens. Five tokens.') → stakes as four tiles (L5, 22.84–30.00 s: reads / writes / pays / holds) → definition restated as the close (L6, 30.00–34.658 s: 'So that's a token: not a word — a chunk of text, counted by machines.') → silent 3.0 s NEXT bridge (bed only) → outro to 41.998 s. Words: phrases of ≤3 words, cumulative arrival at the spoken moment, completed phrase HOLDS while the next reveals and clears when the phrase after next starts (C-05), in two alternating lower bands (centres y=1290/1410), at most 6 words on screen at once. The locked line windows are contiguous — no inter-line silence gaps are built into the narration windows; the designed silences are the 3.0 s bridge and the outro.
